scope: Owner 2026-11-08 requests broad joint parameter discovery on the market-wide Monday lower-1.618 reversal; benchmarks BTC, ETH, SOL and equal-dollar initial altcoin basket.
primary_outcome: net return per admitted 1x event, equally weighted across signals, initial basket equal-dollar at entry; both market fills 5bp, no funding/slippage base. No adding collateral.
rules: Require complete scheduled observation and entry/exit quotes. Deduplicate by taking the chronological first eligible signal and blocking entries for max(24h,H) after each accepted entry. Reset at each fixed evaluation epoch. No equity-based exits in the grid; excursions are labels only.
purge: Use only trades whose exit is strictly before next epoch; report first 2 development blocks, 2025 selection check and locked 2026 to October. Historical years previously inspected; not a blind forward test.
ranking: Per epoch conservative score = mean of returns clipped at +/-20 percentage points minus 1.28 standard errors of clipped returns. Initial rank takes worse of pre-2023 and 2023-24. Require >=12 events in each block, >=30 combined, each period positive raw mean, >=50% combined win. Keep up to 6 distinct date-path candidates per asset and W from each of 3 ranks (conservative score, win rate, capped mean) then pick using minimum of all 3 epoch lower scores; validation requires >=10 events, >=4 calendar months, win >=50%, positive mean, closing-equity drawdown <=35%. No 2026 information in ranking. Parameter-equivalent candidates collapse by their admission paths in development only; report searched and unique separately.
baselines: all W5 X30 H144 all N any Y
same coin/time bucket/volatility random with exclusion of shocks
robustness: Recompute 2026 event count, hit rate, average, median, worst, drawdown, geometric growth, remove best event and best month, cost stress; matched same-symbol UTC month/session/volatility/trend randomized times. Paired cluster-month sign flips with Holm across primary four targets. Require >=10 events, >=6 distinct months, >=50% paired coverage, positive excess with family-adjusted p<.01, positive after subtracting 0.20 percentage points adverse round-trip costs and removing best month to call a validated edge.
exit_followup: For the frozen shortlist representative per asset, bounded alternative exit study: per-instrument limit take profit (5%/10%) and time exit as baseline; if appropriate also early market exit on a completed-bar loss or profit rule for realistic executable contrasts. Select or compare on preceding data, always retest later. No alt synchronized peak assumed.
data: Original 626-symbol weekly same-side first-touch ledger. USTC counts for breadth but is excluded from altcoin returns. Use Binance USDT perpetual candles. NY Monday observations have no usable signal monitoring; full-clock filter; prior studies are available for exact baseline comparison.

owner_exit_extension.objective: Owner requires flexible profit taking and risk control, cash capture for altcoins, and at least 10000 BTC points on the Sep 16 case. Evaluate actual size-weighted fills and fees in addition to maximum excursion.
owner_exit_extension.scope: Study price-proportional trailing stops, completed-bar ATR/chandelier trailing, no early take profit, trend exit, and a partial profit with a runner. Vary loss protection, activation and maximum horizon, including a 6-day reference. Predefine parameter families without using the September price path to set constants.
owner_exit_extension.diagnostic: For the Sep 16, 2026 Beijing breadth event report rule admission, entry, exit VWAP, gross and net BTC points, path ceiling and share of available upside retained. Distinguish the target-conditioned choice from the time-locked selection and report results outside the episode; for basket average member capture separately where defined and disclose timing.
